03/07 — The deals

Notable clients.

Needs input Deal 1 — name it ◇ Customer (or anonymised: "top-3 retail account"). What made it complex — size, number of products, number of stakeholders. What you specifically drove. The outcome.
Needs input Deal 2 — name it ◇ Same shape: customer, complexity, your specific role, outcome. A renewal or expansion counts as much as a new logo.
Needs input Deal 3 — name it ◇ Optional third — only include if it adds a different flavour (different industry, different product line, a save/turnaround story).
Needs input Customer voice ◇ Evidence of trust at multiple levels of one account — not just one contact. A line from a practitioner AND a line from someone more senior, even paraphrased.
Needs input Tenure & consistency ◇ How long have you delivered at this level? One strong deal reads as a moment — a track record across multiple cycles reads as a pattern.

04/07 — Beyond the deals

Beyond the deals.

On the record✓ Create the future Gen AI thought leadership 2+ years running as a go-to voice on Firefly & GenStudio across MAX, Summit, and MWC.
On the record External visibility Repeated, requested-by-name presence at Adobe's biggest stages — not a one-off.
On the record✓ Raise the barMentoring / enablement
  • Conducted various enablement sessions for CXO colleagues
  • Co-defined the format for Adobe's intern onboarding bootcamp
  • Currently mentoring three junior team members on confidence and craft
On the record✓ Raise the barInternal recognition
  • Multiple-time winner of SC of the Quarter, plus the Customer Centricity Award
  • Regular contributor to the global SKO demo challenge
  • Winner of the global US vs EMEA demo challenge during lockdown
On the record✓ Own the outcomeProduct / process influence

Multiple years spent as a bridge between high-value customers and Adobe product teams — carrying real customer requirements back to product and seeing them show up in the roadmap.

  • Firefly Services: helped close the first EMEA sale (Brandtech) — POC through to live adoption, with product gaps fed back and actioned
  • Firefly Graph: ran a POC with Inizio alongside product and product marketing — customer feedback heard and shipped
Needs input Cross-functional project ◇ One project you drove end-to-end, beyond a single deal — internal build, cross-team initiative, anything with a start and a finish.
Needs input Partner & ecosystem recognition ◇ Any recognition or reliance from partners/SIs, not just Adobe-internal or customer-facing. P50 explicitly names "the broader ecosystem."
Needs input Team-culture building ◇ Distinct from mentoring — have you shaped a team environment that's open, inclusive, and high-performing? A moment where you set that tone counts.
